summary: Algiers-born Alexandre Villaplane captained France at the first World Cup in 1930, fell into match-fixing and crime, then led an SS-backed North African unit that tortured, robbed and massacred French civilians before his execution in 1944.

evidence.note: birth in Algiers on Christmas Eve 1904
first France cap against Belgium in 1926, start of main span
long background on the 1830 French conquest and colonial rule of Algeria
proposals to use Saharan slave trade captives and tolerated slaveholding in Algeria
captains France at the 1930 World Cup in Uruguay
match-fixing and bribery scheme at Antibes, stripped title
1935 horse-race fixing conviction and drift into Paris underworld
Henri Lafont recruits criminals for the SS, founding the French Gestapo
made officer of the SS-backed North African Brigade
account of torture, burning and shooting of peasants during a raid
hostage massacres in Dordogne towns including Mussidan
arrest August 1944 and execution by firing squad December 1944
